Every product icon carries the Box Of Rules sign path from marks/box-of-rules/icon-*.svg, unchanged. Every SVG is cropped to its content (no margin, no background); every listed png is the same mark, transparent, 1024 px on the long edge. Cards are the one padded form. If a surface is not listed, ask James; never invent, redraw or recolour a mark.

A plugin not listed here has never had a type pass: it is running on the operating system's default faces, which is a default, not a decision.

picking-fingers.heading: Oswald

picking-fingers.note: Brand faces, from 20 Sep 2026, alongside the existing Anton wordmark. The rest of the editor still falls back to the OS default monospace.

br108.heading: Futura (macOS system font)
br108.never: the brand faces. James, 1 Sep 2026: "branded fonts are not going to fit a vintage style - this is a neve style". Confirmed again 20 Sep 2026: this plugin keeps its vintage feel and is exempt from Oswald + Barlow.
br108.licence: Futura is PROPRIETARY and is not in this kit and cannot be. It ships with macOS under Apple’s licence, so it is available on a Mac and absent on Windows.
br108.open: Windows builds have no Futura and will fall back to something arbitrary. That gap is unresolved. An OFL geometric such as Jost* would substitute closely and could live in fonts/desktop/, but picking the face is James’s call, not a default to be applied quietly.

focus.heading: unchanged
focus.never: any type or layout change. James, 20 Sep 2026: "DON’T TOUCH FOCUS - that’s immutable". It is co-branded with Goghini, so its look is not ours alone to move.

products.$optimised: Every raster in products/ and marks/ has two generated siblings beside it: <name>.min.<ext> (same format, smaller, no visible loss: PNG lossless, JPEG mozjpeg q90) and <name>.webp (q90). Originals are untouched and are what a version folder guarantees. Web pages use .webp with the .min fallback; link the original when fidelity matters (press, print). Made by `npm run images` (tools/images.mjs, sharp).
